F2HYST.title: Hysterectomy (operation during past 5 years)
F2HYST.$comment: Checkbox-style: the source documents only '1=Yes', no '2=No', unlike recruitment's RHYST (which has both). Steward confirmed the semantic relationship to F2HYSTAG matches recruitment's confirmed RHYST/RHYSTAG pattern, but explicitly declined to enforce it as a schema rule -- with no explicit No code to key an if/then off of, enforcing either half would risk conflating 'no hysterectomy' with 'genuinely unrecorded', so both fields are left independent -- D088.

F2HYSTAG.title: Age at hysterectomy
F2HYSTAG.$comment: Source states no valid range; null is included as a legal value (in case it's coded that way in practice) but deliberately not enforced by any mother-file conditional -- steward's call, D088. Bound removed entirely -- source states no range for this field; the earlier agent-decided/derived plausibility bound was retired per Montse's dictionary-fidelity requirement (D101-D104).
